product.title: Feast at Mokapu Luau in Wailea

description.text: Indulge in a delicious feast and Hawaiian culture during the Mokapu Luau at the Andaz Maui. Take your seat on the grassy lawn and watch performers as they take you through Hawaiian history and the Polynesian culture that has created the island. Stops include Mokapu Luau Grounds, Imu Ceremony, Oceanfront Performance Stage. Enjoy a delicious plated, ohana-style meal as well as unlimited handcrafted cocktails while you watch the performance. Ideal for visitors basing on Maui who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
